{{Quote|Oh no, Bursas! Wesa under attack! Help!|One of Otoh Sancture's citizens when the bursas attacked Otoh Sancture|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
A '''clan''' of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]], a [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] race of carnivores native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], were under the influence of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] warlord on Naboo during a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes. In [[3000 BBY]], Rogoe had the bursas [[Destruction of Otoh Sancture|attack]] the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Otoh Sancture]] to attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], the city's leader who Rogoe had grown to fear, however Gallo was absent from his city and escaped its destruction. The bursas later constructed nests on the ruins of Otoh Sancture, but were [[Battle of Otoh Sancture|driven out]] by Gallo, who went on to defeat Rogoe.
